name: 34668 · Port Richey, FL
findings: ZIP 34668 (Port Richey) has 81 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34668 (Port Richey) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 34668 (Port Richey) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 41% of the typical level).
